notes: This pass expands only combat and traversal frame canvases to reduce boundary contact and clipping risk.
Idle and run are unchanged because they passed the prior boundary check.
Artwork content was preserved from the accepted candidate package; this pass repacks frames into wider cells rather than redesigning poses.
If a pose was already truncated in the accepted source frame, that truncation cannot be restored without new art.

pivot_guideline.grounded_frames: Use bottom-center-ish anchor, preserving prior gameplay alignment; X offset is widened by +24 px vs the accepted candidate package.
pivot_guideline.airborne_frames: Use the same Y baseline logic as the accepted candidate; visual content preserved, only canvas widened.
